Description1: Understands the basic concepts of the skill but with minimal experience, context and perspective, requires clear instruction and direction.
Description2: Can discuss and apply terminology, concepts, principles, and issues related to this skill at a basic level. Requires ongoing supervision, decreasing as experience is gained.
Description3: Successfully completes skill-associated tasks independently. Minimal guidance required; usually only in highly complex applications.
Description4: Performs skill related actions successfully and completely independently. Actively coaches others on skill and can apply skill in complex or nuanced situations.
Description5: Provides regular coaching to others related to this area of expertise, inside and outside the organization. Is strategic in skill application, evolving skill as needed across complex situations.
